stretch launch diagonally while support remains absent
bend the rise into a moving crescent apex
tip the crescent into gravity without freezing the apex
pitch torso forward while lead leg begins to open
sharpen unsupported leg scissor before contact
let pelvis keep descending while trail leg sweeps under
convert deep vertical crush into a grounded forward skid
release skid compression crookedly instead of reversing it
settle lower body while preserving shoulder-height and arm-lag asymmetry

keys.causal_role: forward-ready before-state with uneven arm carriage
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root is stable but already biased right; one shoulder leads and the rear hip is loaded.
keys.name: READY_SPLIT

keys.causal_role: asymmetric crouch stores vertical impulse and forward shear
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops behind the future travel line; rear/left hip loads while shoulders counter-rotate.
keys.name: REAR_HIP_COIL

keys.causal_role: rear support owns launch while lead side begins to unload
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root shears forward from the rear/left contact; lead foot is light before support break.
keys.name: REAR_TOE_SHEAR

keys.causal_role: earned support break launches the committed body
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both supports are gone; root is already moving right/up from the loaded rear side.
keys.name: DIAGONAL_RELEASE

keys.causal_role: fast rise stretches the silhouette while rear limbs lag
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root climbs sharply right; trailing arm and rear leg remain behind the torso to expose acceleration.
keys.name: RISE_STRETCH

keys.causal_role: moving apex curls one side while the other side stays long
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Vertical spacing tightens without hover; root continues right while the body forms an asymmetric crescent.
keys.name: APEX_CRESCENT

keys.causal_role: gravity begins to fold the long rising shape
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root has crossed the apex and descends right; knees fold unevenly and the rear arm trails high.
keys.name: GRAVITY_CURL

keys.causal_role: body commits nose-forward into a landing-readable descent
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root drops faster; torso pitches forward, lead leg opens down, and arms counter-swing rather than mirror.
keys.name: DESCENT_KNIFE

keys.causal_role: unsupported scissor prepares a staggered landing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead/left foot reaches groundward first while trail leg stays folded; root still owns full downward debt.
keys.name: PRECONTACT_SCISSOR

keys.causal_role: first support reacquisition occurs before vertical speed is paid
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Lead/left foot catches at ground while pelvis continues down/right; contact is an event, not a stop.
keys.name: LEAD_CATCH

keys.causal_role: lead support bends while trail leg swings under the falling center
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root keeps descending and moving forward over the lead support; trail foot races toward a later catch.
keys.name: TRAIL_SWEEP_UNDER

keys.causal_role: deep compression pays the largest vertical debt after both feet own support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root bottoms after the trail foot joins; knees split unevenly and torso counterleans against forward carry.
keys.name: TWO_FOOT_CRUSH

keys.causal_role: grounded skid carries the root past the compression point
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Vertical debt is mostly paid, but horizontal momentum drags both supports right while shoulders counterlean left.
keys.name: SKID_OVERRUN

keys.causal_role: grounded rebound releases compression without erasing lateral debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root rises only within grounded support and continues right; shoulders unwind unevenly with residual skid torque.
keys.name: CROOKED_REBOUND

keys.causal_role: rebound momentum overshoots onto the right support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root passes neutral; right foot temporarily owns recovery while the left side lifts and the torso stays crooked.
keys.name: RIGHT_SIDE_OVERSHOOT

keys.causal_role: feet restack before the upper body finishes paying recovery debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both supports return, but rear/left shoulder and arm remain visibly late behind the pelvis.
keys.name: SHOULDER_LAG

keys.causal_role: displaced recovery holds asymmetry after the landing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root remains far from its start; torso is still canted and the rear arm has not returned to neutral carriage.
keys.name: RECOVERY_CROOK

keys.causal_role: ground speed re-enters only after vertical and recovery debt are visibly paid
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root resumes rightward travel from a displaced stack; right support owns the renewed stride.
keys.name: RUN_REENTRY

keys.causal_role: forward travel is restored at a new root address rather than rewound
keys.motion_arc_root_note: The next stride transfers support and keeps the displaced travel history visible.
keys.name: RETURN_STRIDE

principle: LANDING PAYS VERTICAL DEBT BEFORE GROUND SPEED RE-ENTERS. A staggered catch keeps the root falling after first contact, crushes deeper after two-foot support, then skids, rebounds, overshoots, and settles before travel is allowed back.
